sub_indicators.label: AI in sector systems
sub_indicators.subject: tech.ai
sub_indicators.text: Use of AI in sectoral management information systems: AI in sector systems
sub_indicators.norm_short: The Continental AI Strategy asks for AI adopted in the core sectors, with national centres of excellence or datasets supporting it and outcomes reported.
criteria: A source from the past three years says no public sector's system uses AI.
An AI tool for a public health, education, agriculture, tax, customs or other sector's system is piloted, tested or being built.
An AI tool is in service in a public sector's system and producing outputs, such as diagnoses, risk scores, forecasts or notices.
AI tools are in service in the public systems of two or more sectors.
Measured results of a sectoral AI system in service are reported, such as cases detected, revenue recovered or accuracy.
